alt: 園藝負責人抱著幾只小杯子搬水，轉頭擺手拒絕，志工用澆水壺為幼苗澆水，旁邊還有許多乾燥的苗床。
scene_prompt: In a community garden an older organizer stubbornly insists on carrying water from the nearby tap with many tiny old cups, walking tiredly past thirsty seedlings. A younger volunteer offers a simple wide watering can already filled at the same tap, clearly demonstrating a gentle useful shower onto one seedling. The organizer pushes the helpful watering can away with a dismissive palm while clinging to their handful of small cups. Show refusal of an obviously sensible easy improvement because of attachment to the old method, not conservation, a rule or disability. Two people, ordinary safe objects, no writing, labels or diagram arrows.
